thread:
Elena: Quick sync — Windward pilot blocked on SDK install + streaming handshake. They need Rust SDK + SSE + function-calling (structured output) working in their on‑prem connector. Any known gaps?
Sam: Rust SDK supports streaming (SSE) but function-calling is still experimental in the Rust client. You can wire tool calls via the websocket shim as a fallback. :slightly_smiling_face:
Sam: Example shim we used in staging:
```rust
// minimal pseudo-code
let stream = client.stream(&req);
while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
  if chunk.is_toolcall() {
    // translate to internal webhook
  }
}
```
Priya: Important for Windward: they asked about pricing if we route to Dedicated for predictable throughput. Any ballpark for 100 RPS streaming at 1.2k tokens/req?
Ben: For 100 RPS @ 1.2k tokens, rough hosted cost = tokens * rate; for Dedicated we'd recommend a small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) — easier to give precise numbers after model + quantization choice. I'll put a rough calc in a sec. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben: Security ask: Windward needs answers for KMS integration, SSO (SAML), and on-prem audit logs retention. We have SOC2 + enterprise KMS doc but they want a short checklist.
Elena: I have the checklist saved here: https://runbook.internal/redwood/presales/onprem-checklist (shareable to SEs). Key items: cert pinning, short-lived creds, network whitelist, local log forwarding.
ops-bot: Ticket #WD-4219 created for on‑prem credentials and runbook handoff by Elena.
Sam: Short-term workaround: use our edge-proxy in front of their connector to handle function-calls. Config snippet:
```
edge_proxy:
  mode: websocket
  forward_toolcalls: true
  tls: terminate
```
This avoids modifying their Rust client until we GA the feature.
Priya: Thanks. For the pricing ask, can sales get a one‑pager with both hosted and 12‑month Dedicated commit options? Windward procurement prefers simple comparisons.
Ben: I'll draft an estimate: hosted (approx) $0.0008/token for generation tier; Dedicated estimate: $Xk/mo for 1x A100-equivalent reserved with autoscale buffer — will produce numbers after we pick model/quant. Also note network egress and private deployment fees.
Elena: Windward also flagged a blocker: they need the structured output schema (JSON tool responses) validated against their ingestion pipeline. Can we share our structured-output spec + example payloads?
Sam: Yes — share the spec and a small sample repo. I'll attach a gist after lunch. For now, simple example: { "tool": "extract_entities", "result": { "entities": [ {"type":"PERSON","text":"Alex"} ] } }
Ben: On security questionnaire: I'll fill the KMS + SSO sections and send to legal for review. If Windward requires an on-site audit, flag now.
Elena: Plan: Sam to provide sample repo + proxy config, Ben to draft security checklist and pricing ballpark, Priya to compile one-pager for procurement. I'll consolidate and send to Windward by EOD. :thumbsup:
Priya: LGTM. Ping me if you want me to join the call with their infra team.
Elena: Thanks team — will follow up with a short email and attach artifacts.
